name: Extract hooks, CTAs and transcripts from a competitor's Facebook ads to Google Sheets with Apify

parameters.content:
# Extract hooks, CTAs and transcripts from a competitor's Facebook ads to Google Sheets with Apify

Point it at one competitor and get a spreadsheet teardown of their active Facebook video ads: hook, CTA, length, language and full transcript, one row per ad.

### Who it's for
Media buyers and creative strategists who want a competitor's whole ad account on one sheet.

### How it works
1. A Set node holds the competitor's Facebook Page URL (or any Ad Library search URL) and the number of ads to fetch.
2. An HTTP Request starts the Facebook Ads Library scraper on Apify, then an If node and a polling request wait until the run finishes.
3. The finished run's dataset ID is handed straight to the Facebook Ads Transcript Scraper on Apify, so no ad rows pass through n8n. Each video is transcribed and its hook and CTA extracted. Expired links and music-only ads come back as uncharged misses.
4. A Code node shapes one row per ad, a Set node tidies the columns and a Google Sheets node appends them.

### Setup
1. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential (name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`) and select it on the three HTTP Request nodes.
2. Connect Google Sheets and pick the spreadsheet and sheet.
3. Open the Config node, set the competitor URL and how many ads to process.
4. Run the workflow.

### Requirements
An Apify account (the free plan's credit covers a small test run) and a Google account.

### Customization tips
Swap the scraper for any Ad Library scraper, the transcript step reads the run's dataset by ID. Sort or filter rows in the Code node. Add a Schedule Trigger to re-run weekly and catch new creatives.

## 1. Configure
Your input URL and item count live in one Set node.

## 2. Scrape and wait
Start the Apify scraper run, then poll it every few seconds until it finishes.

## 3. Transcribe and shape rows
Hand the run's dataset ID to the transcript actor, then build one row per item.

## 4. Save
Append the rows to Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: competitorUrl = a Facebook Ad Library search URL (set media_type=video) OR a competitor's Facebook Page URL (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/nike). maxAds = how many ads to pull.

nodes.name: Start Ad Library scrape (competitor)
nodes.notes: Starts curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper and waits up to 60s. Returns the run object — we only need data.defaultDatasetId. To use another Ad Library scraper, swap the actor slug + the JSON body to its input fields.

nodes.name: Wait for scrape (poll run)
nodes.notes: Loops back until the scraper run finishes (each poll waits up to 60s server-side).

nodes.name: Transcribe ads by dataset ID: hooks & CTAs
nodes.notes: Chains steadyfetch/facebook-ads-transcript-scraper on the scraper run's dataset ID. One row per ad: transcript + first-3s hook + CTA + metadata. Charged only when a transcript is delivered.

nodes.name: Teardown table (one row per item)
nodes.notes: Terminal step: a clean spreadsheet-shaped row per ad. Wire Google Sheets / Airtable / Slack / a database after this node.

main.node: Transcribe ads by dataset ID: hooks & CTAs
